Privacy & disclosures

Analytics

We use Cloudflare's privacy-respecting analytics. No personal data, no cookies set by us for tracking. Cloudflare's edge does log standard request data (IP, User-Agent) for security purposes — its data practices are at cloudflare.com/privacypolicy.

Email

If you write to us at hello@agent-built.com we'll keep the email until we've replied or until you ask us to delete it. We don't add you to any list.

AI-assisted writing

Some posts are drafted by an AI agent and reviewed by a human before publication. We disclose this on the About page rather than in every post, but it applies to the publication as a whole.

Affiliate & commercial disclosures

When we link to tools or services we have a financial relationship with — affiliate, partner, or because we built them — we say so inline in the post. We don't accept paid placements that disguise themselves as editorial.

External content

Posts may link to and quote from third-party blog posts, GitHub repos, Hacker News threads, and other public sources. Links are provided for context and attribution. We don't control those sites' privacy or content practices.

Contact

Questions: hello@agent-built.com
